node.title: KoalaBear active balanced-core bad-slope to component bridge
node.statement: Conditional on a concrete source-bound compiler for the active balanced-core certificate and a same-record realization of each compiled witness as an actual Q=6,s=6,u=2 endpoint component, every slope in the deployed KoalaBear Z_BC cell is assigned on the same received line, with its support and affine slope unchanged, to exactly one live component type (m,r,delta)=(2,4,2) or (2,8,1). The assignment is first-match exhaustive and disjoint and carries an injection or exact finite fiber multiplicities from slopes to records/components. No parameter-line point is identified with an evaluation-carrier point.
node.falsifier: An active Z_BC slope with no actual component record, a component outside the two live types, two owners assigned to one slope, loss of support or affine-slope identity, or an unbounded/unprinted record multiplicity.
